lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: The scratched pod is yours. Frost beads across the glass while the broker quietly stops answering messages.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: No readable contract. No useful ID. There is one obvious test.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: If you are done knocking, open the latch.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: You are awake. That is already better than the warranty.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: Sera Vale. Pilot. I would very much like to know what year it is after we get off this dock.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: *The knock runs dead against the glass.*

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: Nothing. No movement. No readable vitals beyond the pod's own green light. The broker has stopped answering. You have been scammed.
